5653972.name: Sacramento Jewish Academy
5653972.note: J., Sept 20 2022 (Sue Fishkoff and Rachel Raskin-Zrihen, 'Sacramento-area school fills void for growing Chabad community'): 'Started as a homeschool nine years ago, the Sacramento Jewish Academy now enrolls nearly 100 children, pre-K through eighth grade. Rabbi Mendy Cohen, the school's dean who has directed Chabad of Sacramento since 1994 ...'; it had just bought a former church ('We closed Aug. 17 and started classes Aug. 29'). Counted back, so medium (the chabad.org listing is from 2022, the move).

earlier.where: a homeschool (its start, about 2013), before the former church it bought in Aug 2022
